scope: Prior 39 deterministic CLI cases plus one requested missing-parent-durable-source case, at both pinned gates (80 runs). Clean task/durable source bindings and parent durable fixture exist BEFORE mutation at BOTH pins. No models, candidate or validator execution, Monte Carlo, archive mutations or remote PID inference.

fixture_contract.required_augmentation: For both pins the same clean branch fixture now binds design task digest, branch durable bytes and parent durable bytes before mutation, and writes a synthetic parent durable file. The report is not refreshed after the case mutation. The task digest is fixture metadata matching design; no task file is needed by this gate contract.
fixture_contract.new_case: Delete/omit only the parent durable file after its clean digest is established; old contract permits it, new contract must reject. No other new cases.
fixture_contract.recovery: Valid ledgered adaptive recovery passes at both pins; undeclared recovery and malformed ledger cases reject.

published_tests.note: Executed separately against pinned current gate/test sources; not rerun by this audit script. The reported 101-test full suite was not reproduced here.

report.method: transcript rebuilt from the frozen task file, frozen certified visible tests and the parent's recorded stage-0 reply and trace; hashed and compared with the hash the parent logged before its own t=1 model call. No model or candidate code was executed.
report.caveat: this verifies the recorded transcript hash and the stored flag. It does not re-execute the tool, so `tool_result_reproduced` is reported as stored, not independently recomputed.

actual_report_binding.note: Independent pinned byte/ID checks and AST literal-only verification of four prompt constants. The task digest is compared to design here; another reviewer independently regenerates task bytes. Transcript reconstruction and tool execution are not performed by this audit.

accepted: All retained 39 case expectations remain met, including clean branch and legitimate ledgered recovery. The sole new missing-parent-durable case changes from acceptance to ordinary rejection with a named missing-file message.

The report now binds both durable files by exact byte hash, and its task digest must equal the frozen design digest. Pinned saved bytes and all 800 covered IDs match; all 20 non-analysis artifacts remain unchanged.

A missing bound source now produces an explicit diagnostic instead of an exception. An uncaught FileNotFoundError already produces a nonzero CLI exit: under a correctly enforced zero-exit publication gate it is not itself a successful bypass. The handoff/PROGRESS claim otherwise is overstated.
source_limits: Task binding is to design["tasks_sha256"], not a new read/hash of actual task-file bytes by verify_stage.py. The reconstruction helper does hash loaded task bytes; independent regeneration is separate evidence.

prompt_helper_revision is recorded but never compared by verify_stage.py. It hashes SYS_CODE, ASK_REPAIR, SYS_TEST and ASK_TESTS constants, not the task_prompt/signature_line/repair_message implementations that also determine transcript bytes, nor the verifier revision.

Durable file hashes bind a saved snapshot, but the reconstruction helper does not compare durable transcript/state/probability fields row-by-row with nested records. The gate still checks durable full keys/actions, not all other fields. This is a remaining generic scope limit, not an allegation of corrupt data.
Actual-host writer exclusion, atomic publication, model/runtime attestation, tool-result reexecution and reconstruction of the operator-reported lost completions remain outside this audit.

accepted.finding: 11,567 calls now scoped to retained log/live completions; GPU checks correctly described as observations at episode start, not continuous monitoring.
800 continuations, two replicates per arm per prefix, 200 prefixes and 103 tasks explicitly distinguished; this corrects the unit count.

unresolved.finding: Branch status and body still call estimates compatible on the basis of an uncalibrated exploratory band. Requested descriptive replacement remains outstanding.

Every estimate below averages replicates and clusters is too broad (the 0.080 paired-disagreement statistic and restoration counts do not use that calculation). The later statement that replication is not accounted for remains too categorical: branch_linkage_linearized.py lines45-52 already averages each arm within prefix before task scores. What remains unproved is the sampling-model justification for joint uncertainty.
After correctly saying the timeout effect is not established, the paragraph still concludes that timeouts cannot have moved a result. No sensitivity analysis supports that guarantee.

readme_review.prior_requested_wording: docs/theory_feedback_20260920_integration.md items2 and4; current source-model feedback reiterates these requests.

interpretation: Accepted fixes improve checker diagnostics and snapshot binding. They do not establish complete input/template/durable semantic validation or scientific interval coverage. No new adversarial cases were added beyond the requested missing reference. No claim of archived corruption or new empirical evidence.
